analytic_rates._: Tail volumes measured on icarus-B (AUDIT-A.md): arms = |bbox mid x| from the datum moment reference; V-tail (cant 62.5 deg) split cos^2/sin^2 into pitch/yaw projections of its 0.100 m2; a from Helmbold 2*pi*AR/(2+sqrt(AR^2+4)); eta 0.9; deps/dalpha = 2*CL_alpha/(pi*AR_wing) = 2*4.03/(pi*8.065) = 0.32. Predicts Cm_q+adot ~ -8.0, Cn_r ~ -0.063.

validity.notes: VLM: no stall, no transonic effects; alpha beyond ~12 deg and the 30 deg flap detent carry attached-flow optimism. cl_max_estimate marks likely-stalled grid points in validity.stall.
